summary: Rock Health describes itself as a pre-seed, seed and Series A digital health venture fund investing in entrepreneurs at the intersection of healthcare and technology, alongside an enterprise advisory group and a non-profit. Its site publishes digital health funding research, for example an H1 2026 funding overview. Check size, geography, an application route, portfolio examples on the homepage and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed, so those points need direct confirmation.

investmentEvidence.fact: The Capital page states the fund invests in entrepreneurs at the intersection of healthcare and technology; individual portfolio companies are not listed on the pages reviewed.

sources.title: Homepage: fund description, stages and sector, advisory and non-profit arms
Capital page: investment focus statement and research
